input: Original sampled quotes and surrounding article text in ProQuest; metadata only from sample manifests.
prior_exposure: Aggregate validation counts and manuscript summaries were visible while correcting provenance. No claim-level comparison or response files opened.
comparison: Not performed. Claim-level author and GPT-4o-mini labels remain unopened. Join by audit_id only after this freeze; report historical and modern frames separately.
review_method: Read each sampled source claim and surrounding article context in the source-only Jupyter reader inside ProQuest TDM Studio; expand context for interpretation when needed. No outcome scoring.

field_notes.horizon_months: Coarse 6/12/vague categorization. Short, long, unspecified, or event-relative horizons use vague.
field_notes.speaker_name: Person name or surname visible in reviewed context; na if not established. Institutional attributions do not count as person names.
field_notes.current_state: From the sampled claim, not unrelated surrounding article descriptions.
field_notes.null: Ambiguous included-claim field; retain in agreement denominator/reporting as missing or unresolved, never as an agreement.
field_notes.na: Not applicable or not established under the rubric.
field_notes.direction: Overall economic or market framing; ambiguous compound/non-increase claims may be unclear.
